row: The AAHA channel is dedicated to provide information for pet owners and veterinary professionals.The only association that accredits small-animal hospitals throughout the U.S. and Canada, the American Animal Hospital Association evaluates practices on approximately 900 standards. More than 3,500 hospitals have earned the AAHA-accredited designation.
